tool_calls.demotion_condition: if Graphs.degree is not called in the current rerun, demote to supportive
tool_calls.input_object: committed n3/n4/n5/n6/n7/n8 per-site z coordinates plus support graph edges
tool_calls.output_object: named static network-level shell coordinate/control row
tool_calls.positive_case: degree weighted coordinates are finite and label independent
tool_calls.negative/erased_control: unweighted mean conflation and moved-site controls recomputed
tool_calls.boundary_case: n3/n6/n7/n8 equal-degree graphs and n4/n5 unequal-degree graphs

tool_calls.demotion_condition: if Manifolds.mean does not gate all_pass/divergence, demote to supportive
tool_calls.input_object: per-site shell manifold points from eta/theta/z plus support-graph degree weights

tool_calls.positive_case: n4/n5 Sphere(2) Frechet z differs from chart-space weighted z_bar where curvature matters; n6/n7/n8 compute the same row as equal-degree boundaries
tool_calls.negative/erased_control: like-for-like chart-space weighted z_bar comparison and n3/n6/n7/n8 equal-degree boundary rows
tool_calls.boundary_case: n3/n6/n7/n8 equal-degree shell rows plus n4/n5 unequal-degree curved shell rows

tool_calls.demotion_condition: if equality statuses are not produced by Z3.check over bound raw values, demote to supportive
tool_calls.input_object: scaled finite z values for original and swapped configurations plus support-graph degree weights
tool_calls.output_object: SAT/UNSAT equality statuses for unweighted, weighted, erased-weight, and permuted controls
tool_calls.positive_case: unweighted equality is SAT while weighted equality is UNSAT
tool_calls.negative/erased_control: erased weights flip equality to SAT; permuted paired control preserves weighted UNSAT
